description: One transfer framework: its row, authority, codes with their meanings, and the courses mapped to it (resolved), a page at a time. Narrow the courses to one school (unitid) or one framework code (code); more pages carry next_offset. Each row names its current FORM's wording source: source_url, capture_file, catalog_year and source_catalog_name are that one source's, never the record's whole span. A row whose record holds more than one form or more than one source also carries version_count, source_count, first_edition_seen and last_edition_seen, and one sentence saying so in words; a record with one form and one source carries none of them and reads exactly as it always has. The forms themselves, each with its own content and its own sources, come from the one-record get, never from a list. A record last seen in an older edition says so, because the Union keeps a record no current catalog prints.

code.description: Optional: only this framework code (e.g. ENGL 1010), spacing and case ignored

unitid.description: Optional: only the courses mapped at this school, by IPEDS UNITID
